title: Parceiro com servidor legado não consegue mais chamar nossa API depois que a raiz cruzada da CA expirou
what_it_tests: Reconhecer que nenhum deploy nosso causou o problema: é o trust store desatualizado do cliente. Testa não inventar culpado entre os deploys.

ticket.subject: Partner integration failing: 'certificate has expired' when calling our API
ticket.description: Partner Wayne Logistics says their order-sync job can no longer call our partner API. Their error: 'SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired'. Our certificate is valid until next year and browsers show no warning. Their job runs on an old CentOS 6 server. Service: acme/partner-api.

comments.author: Priya (Support Eng)
comments.body: Other partners are calling the API fine. Wayne's last successful call was yesterday before midnight UTC.

related_tickets.subject: Old Android devices show certificate warnings on our app domain
related_tickets.resolution: Those devices' trust store does not include the new root after the old cross-signed root expired. The client must update its CA bundle. Nothing to fix on our certificate.

logs.message: http: TLS handshake error from 203.0.113.44:51514: remote error: tls: bad certificate
serving chain: leaf -> intermediate R11 -> ISRG Root X1 (legacy cross-sign by old root expired)
http: TLS handshake error from 203.0.113.44:51730: remote error: tls: bad certificate

ground_truth.root_cause: The partner's legacy server has an outdated trust store (old ca-certificates bundle) that does not include the current root. Once the old cross-signed root expired, their client rejects our otherwise valid chain during the TLS handshake. None of our deploys caused this. The partner must update their CA bundle.
